_comment: Single source of truth for per-route public page metadata.
Read by scripts/prerender-public-routes.mjs at build time and by
tests/seo-metadata-contract.test.ts. Plain JSON so the build step needs no
TypeScript toolchain, and so the test and the generator can never disagree
Every path here must be a genuinely public route (a member of PUBLIC_PATHS
in src/App.tsx) and must match public/sitemap.xml exactly -- a contract test
enforces both directions. Titles and descriptions describe only what the
page actually contains: no ratings, prices, certifications, compliance
attestations or safety claims the product cannot evidence.
origin is the apex domain because www.softwarepassportregistry.com answers

pages.title: Software Passport Registry — Verify Software Before You Buy
pages.description: Software trust and evidence verification for buyers and businesses. SPR gives software a persistent identity and reports observed evidence, not inferred safety.

pages.title: Free Software Review — Software Passport Registry
pages.description: Submit a public GitHub repository and see what SPR can actually observe about it. No account required, and the review reports observed evidence only.

pages.title: Sample Software Passport — Software Passport Registry
pages.description: A static sample Software Passport showing how SPR records identity, evidence and unknowns. Demo data only: it reads no customer or tenant data.

pages.title: Software Passport Registry Pricing — Software Verification
pages.description: Pay for the software trust work you use. Compare SPR subscription plans, one-time verification reports and add-ons for MSPs and software teams.

pages.title: Software Passport Registry for MSPs — Software Trust & Risk Visibility
pages.description: Software Passport Registry for MSPs. Track software inventory and evidence across every client, with risk visibility and client-facing trust reporting.

pages.title: Terms of Service — Software Passport Registry
pages.description: The terms governing use of Software Passport Registry, covering account responsibilities, acceptable use, and restrictions on accessing other tenants' data.

pages.title: Privacy Policy — Software Passport Registry
pages.description: How Software Passport Registry collects and uses account, repository, evidence and log data, and how tenant and client data isolation is enforced.
